**To the mayor, re: `@mboetger`'s comment r4606860038 on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152 (PR flutter/flutter#196561, branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, base head `f3d2ab1fd3b`)**

**Status:** The fix is ready to commit locally as a new commit on top of `f3d2ab1fd3b`. I have not pushed and will not push. I couldn't run anything more in this turn, so I have no new head SHA, no output tails and no CI results yet. The steps that would produce them are below.

**What the test showed.** API 35 emulator, playground app built with `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`, no `versionCode` in `android {}` or the manifest:
- **Fresh install works.** `adb uninstall`, then `adb install app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` gives `Success`. `dumpsys package` shows `versionCode=0`.
- **Update over a numbered build fails.** After installing a `versionCode=7` build, `adb install -r` of the same APK gives `Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]`.

So `@mboetger` is right. "which Android refuses to install" is wrong as written. Android refuses only when a build with a positive `versionCode` is already on the device. The flag also gives every split APK the same `versionCode` (0). That is the same Google Play problem that `errorMessage` and the `configureSplitPerAbiVersionCodes` KDoc already describe.

